_comment: Wave 14: land at the start stellar, accept the main-spaceport offer (Return), take off with the recording running, then hand-driven steps (loops/interactive.mjs, inbox ~/.local/share/novaref/inbox/w14.jsonl) until {"done":true}; the pilot is pulled at the end.
